description:
## Summary

`nf-arts` is a Nextflow plugin that turns each run into generative art. When the run ends, it draws its tasks as an SVG or PNG, from their timing, memory and status only.

## Get Started

Add the plugin to `nextflow.config`:

```groovy
plugins {
    id 'nf-arts@1.1.0'
}
```

The run writes `art-<runName>.svg` and `art-<runName>.png` to the launch directory. To add nf-arts to a pipeline you don't edit, see the configuration documentation.

## Examples

Configure the art output in your pipeline:

```groovy
arts {
    file  = "${params.outdir}/pipeline_info/art.png"
    style = 'ginkgo'
}
```

Paint a run that already finished:

```bash
nextflow plugin nf-arts:render --style mondrian --file art.png
```

spec.name: arts
layout
spec.description: How the `hive` style places processes on its spokes: `spiral` or `phase` (default: `spiral`).

spec.name: file
spec.description: Output file; `.svg` or `.png` sets the format (default: `art-<runName>.svg` and `.png`).

spec.name: background
spec.description: Background hex color (default: from the palette).

spec.name: palette
spec.description: Named color palette (default: `viridis`, or the style's own).

spec.name: spokes
spec.description: Number of spokes in the `hive` style, at least 2 (default: `5`).

spec.name: title
spec.description: Caption: pipeline, version, run name and nf-arts version (default: `true`).

spec.name: enabled
spec.description: Draw the artwork when the run ends (default: `true`).
The `arts` scope configures the artwork generated by the nf-arts plugin.
